<thought>Based on the near‑equal intensity of the M and M+2 peaks (≈1 : 1), the spectrum shows the characteristic isotopic pattern of bromine. The noticeable M+1 peak (~9 % of M) matches the expected contribution from ¹³C in a molecule with several carbons, confirming carbon’s presence. No other element shows a definitive isotopic signature in this data.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Br']</final_answer>
